count_notes.hull_types: 90 named definitions; 92 children minus CountHullType=150 and SeriesName UI template. Declared 150 is not actual definition count.
count_notes.micromodules: 274 named definitions; 276 children minus AddToItem confirmation and Name category label.
count_notes.artifacts: 32 named definitions; 36 children minus empty CustomArtefacts, NumericValues and 2 interface strings.
count_notes.equipment: 96 rows = 8 goods + 18 weapon names + 64 technology tier labels (8 categories × 8) + 6 probes. Not 96 finished item instances.
count_notes.text_quests: 320 payloads = 80 Russian + 80 English base + 160 optional German/Spanish translations or fallback English. Translation variants are not unique quests.
count_notes.archive_vs_cards: Map/scenario cards are localization entries; asset presence does not establish gameplay reachability.
count_notes.captains: 1803 pool parameters, not 1803 persistent people in a campaign.

limitations: Resource name pools are not generated campaign objects
Optional mod files are indexed separately; not assumed active
Names and numeric definitions are cataloged, complete original prose is private
Asset payloads (images/audio/maps) are indexed, not all semantically decoded
Successful binary decoding is not complete narrative analysis or proof of reachability
No saves loaded and no game launched
SCR bindings are script aliases, not necessarily displayed world names
QMM placeholder names are quest-local context, not guaranteed galaxy systems
